pli-tv-bu-pm:0.1: Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Dvemātikāpāḷi
pli-tv-bu-pm:1.1: Sammajjanī padīpo ca, udakaṃ āsanena ca;
pli-tv-bu-pm:2.1: Chanda, pārisuddhi, utukkhānaṃ, bhikkhugaṇanā ca ovādo;
pli-tv-bu-pm:3.3: Vajjanīyā ca puggalā tasmiṃ na honti, ‘‘pattakalla’’nti vuccati.
pli-tv-bu-pm:4.1: Pubbakaraṇapubbakiccāni samāpetvā desitāpattikassa samaggassa bhikkhusaṅghassa anumatiyā pātimokkhaṃ uddisituṃ ārādhanaṃ karoma.
pli-tv-bu-pm:5.3: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho uposathaṃ kareyya, pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya.
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.4: taṃ sabbeva santā sādhukaṃ suṇoma manasi karoma.
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.8: Yathā kho pana paccekapuṭṭhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti, evamevaṃ evarūpāya parisāya yāvatatiyaṃ anusāvitaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.9: Yo pana bhikkhu yāvatatiyaṃ anusāviyamāne saramāno santiṃ āpattiṃ nāvikareyya, sampajānamusāvādassa hoti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.10: Sampajānamusāvādo kho panāyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.11: tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddhāpekkhena santī āpatti āvikātabbā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:8.1: Tatrime cattāro pārājikā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:9.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāyapi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso. Adinnādānasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:10.1: Yo pana bhikkhu gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:10.2: yathārūpe adinnādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā corosi bālosi mūḷhosi thenosīti, tathārūpaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ ādiyamāno
pli-tv-bu-pm:11.1: Yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ vāssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:11.2: ‘‘ambho purisa kiṃ tuyhiminā pāpakena dujjīvitena, mataṃ te jīvitā seyyo’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:11.3: iti cittamano cittasaṅkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:12.1: Yo pana bhikkhu anabhijānaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ attupanāyikaṃ alamariyañāṇadassanaṃ samudācareyya ‘‘iti jānāmi, iti passāmī’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:12.2: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā āpanno visuddhāpekkho evaṃ vadeyya ‘‘ajānamevaṃ āvuso avacaṃ jānāmi, apassaṃ passāmi, tucchaṃ musā vilapi’’nti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:13.1: Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pārājikā dhammā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:13.2: Yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:13.3: yathā pure, tathā pacchā, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:14.1: Ime kho panāyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā Dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti. Sukkavissaṭṭhisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:15.1: Sañcetanikā sukkavissaṭṭhi aññatra supinantā saṅghādiseso. Kāyasaṃsaggasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:16.1: Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthaggāhaṃ vā veṇiggāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅghādiseso. Duṭṭhullavācāsikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:17.1: Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāseyya yathā taṃ yuvā yuvatiṃ methunupasaṃhitāhi, saṅghādiseso. Attakāmapāricariyasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:18.1: Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmassa santike attakāmapāricariyāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya ‘‘etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā’’ti methunupasaṃhitena, saṅghādiseso. Sañcarittasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:19.1: Yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthimatiṃ, jāyattane vā jārattane vā, antamaso taṅkhaṇikāyapi, saṅghādiseso. Kuṭikārasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:20.1: Saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ sattantarā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:20.2: bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:20.3: Sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅghādiseso. Vihārakārasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:21.1: Mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena sassāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:21.2: tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:21.3: Sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane mahallakaṃ vihāraṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, saṅghādiseso. Duṭṭhadosasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:22.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya ‘‘appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyya’’nti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:22.2: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā amūlakañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso. Aññabhāgiyasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:23.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya ‘‘appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyya’’nti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:23.2: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā aññabhāgiyañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti kocideso lesamatto upādinno, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso. Saṅghabhedasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.1: Yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkameyya, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha tiṭṭheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.2: ‘‘māyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.3: sametāyasmā saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.4: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.5: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.1: Tasseva kho pana bhikkhussa bhikkhū honti anuvattakā vaggavādakā eko vā dve vā tayo vā, te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.3: dhammavādī ceso bhikkhu, vinayavādī ceso bhikkhu,
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.4: amhākañceso bhikkhu chandañca ruciñca ādāya voharati, jānāti, no bhāsati, amhākampetaṃ khamatī’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.7: na ceso bhikkhu dhammavādī, na ceso bhikkhu vinayavādī,
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.9: sametāyasmantānaṃ saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.10: evañca te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyyuṃ, te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.11: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyyuṃ, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.1: Bhikkhu paneva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.2: ‘‘mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, ahampāyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.5: ‘‘māyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi, vacanīyamevāyasmā attānaṃ karotu,
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.6: āyasmāpi bhikkhū vadatu sahadhammena, bhikkhūpi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena,
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.7: evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññamaññavacanena aññamaññavuṭṭhāpanenā’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.8: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.9: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.1: Bhikkhu paneva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, tassa kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni ca tena duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca,
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.3: ‘‘āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alaṃ te idha vāsenā’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.4: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno te bhikkhū evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.5: ‘‘chandagāmino ca bhikkhū, dosagāmino ca bhikkhū, mohagāmino ca bhikkhū, bhayagāmino ca bhikkhū tādisikāya āpattiyā ekaccaṃ pabbājenti, ekaccaṃ na pabbājentī’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.7: ‘‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, na ca bhikkhū chandagāmino, na ca bhikkhū dosagāmino, na ca bhikkhū mohagāmino, na ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino,
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.8: āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alaṃ te idha vāsenā’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.9: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.10: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.1: Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā dhammā nava paṭhamāpattikā, cattāro yāvatatiyakā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.2: Yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvatīhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti, tāvatīhaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.3: Parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.4: ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.5: Ekenapi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
pli-tv-bu-pm:29.1: Ime kho panāyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā Uddesaṃ āgacchanti. Paṭhamaaniyatasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:30.1: Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappeyya, tamenaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā
pli-tv-bu-pm:30.2: tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyya pārājikena vā saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:30.3: nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo pārājikena vā saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:30.4: yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo,
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.1: Na heva kho pana paṭicchannaṃ āsanaṃ hoti nālaṃkammaniyaṃ, alañca kho hoti mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsituṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.2: yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpe āsane mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya, tamenaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.3: dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyya saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.4: nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.5: yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo,
pli-tv-bu-pm:32.1: Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:33.1: Ime kho panāyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā Dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti. Kathinasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:34.1: Niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine dasāhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaraṃ dhāretabbaṃ, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Udositasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:35.1: Niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine ekarattampi ce bhikkhu ticīvarena vippavaseyya, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Akālacīvarasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:36.1: Niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine bhikkhuno paneva akālacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:36.3: no cassa pāripūri, māsaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā taṃ cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ ūnassa pāripūriyā satiyā paccāsāya.
pli-tv-bu-pm:36.4: Tato ce uttari nikkhipeyya satiyāpi paccāsāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Purāṇacīvarasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:37.1: Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Cīvarapaṭiggahaṇasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:38.1: Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya aññatra pārivattakā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Aññātakaviññattisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:39.1: Yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā cīvaraṃ viññāpeyya aññatra samayā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:39.2: Tatthāyaṃ samayo, acchinnacīvaro vā hoti bhikkhu, naṭṭhacīvaro vā, ayaṃ tattha samayo. Tatuttarisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:40.1: Tañce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santaruttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. Tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Paṭhamaupakkhaṭasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:41.1: Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa aññātakassa gahapatissa vā gahapatāniyā vā cīvaracetāpannaṃ upakkhaṭaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-pm:41.2: ‘‘iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādessāmī’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:41.3: tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:41.4: ‘‘sādhu vata maṃ āyasmā iminā cīvaracetāpannena evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādehī’’ti
pli-tv-bu-pm:42.1: Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa ubhinnaṃ aññātakānaṃ gahapatīnaṃ vā gahapatānīnaṃ vā paccekacīvaracetāpannāni upakkhaṭāni honti
pli-tv-bu-pm:42.2: ‘‘imehi mayaṃ paccekacīvaracetāpannehi paccekacīvarāni cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarehi acchādessāmā’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:42.3: tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:42.4: ‘‘sādhu vata maṃ āyasmanto imehi paccekacīvaracetāpannehi evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādetha ubhova santā ekenā’’ti
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.1: Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa rājā vā rājabhoggo vā brāhmaṇo vā gahapatiko vā dūtena cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.2: ‘‘iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādehī’’ti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.3: So ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.4: ‘‘idaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ, paṭiggaṇhātu āyasmā cīvaracetāpanna’’nti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.5: Tena bhikkhunā so dūto evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.6: ‘‘na kho mayaṃ, āvuso, cīvaracetāpannaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma, cīvarañca kho mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma kālena kappiya’’nti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.7: So ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.9: Cīvaratthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.11: So ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.12: ‘‘yaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi, saññatto so mayā, upasaṅkamatāyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessatī’’ti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.13: Cīvaratthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṅkamitvā dvattikkhattuṃ codetabbo sāretabbo
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.15: dvattikkhattuṃ codayamāno sārayamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.16: no ce abhinipphādeyya, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇhībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.17: catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇhībhūto uddissa tiṭṭhamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.18: tato ce uttari vāyamamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.19: No ce abhinipphādeyya, yatassa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ, tattha sāmaṃ vā gantabbaṃ, dūto vā pāhetabbo
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.20: ‘‘yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇittha, na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhoti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.21: yuñjantāyasmanto sakaṃ, mā vo sakaṃ vinassā’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:44.1: Yo pana bhikkhu kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Suddhakāḷakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:45.1: Yo pana bhikkhu suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Dvebhāgasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:46.1: Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārayamānena dve bhāgā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātabbā, tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:46.2: Anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ, tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ, navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Chabbassasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:47.1: Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārāpetvā chabbassāni dhāretabbaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:47.2: orena ce channaṃ vassānaṃ taṃ santhataṃ vissajjetvā vā avissajjetvā vā aññaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Nisīdanasanthatasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:48.1: Nisīdanasanthataṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya.
pli-tv-bu-pm:48.2: Anādā ce bhikkhu purāṇasantha tassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ, navaṃ nisīdanasanthataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Eḷakalomasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:49.2: ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbāni, paṭiggahetvā tiyojanaparamaṃ sahatthā haritabbāni asante hārake.
pli-tv-bu-pm:49.3: Tato ce uttari hareyya, asantepi hārake, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Eḷakalomadhovāpanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:50.1: Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā eḷakalomāni dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā vijaṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Rūpiyasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:51.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Rūpiyasaṃvohārasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:52.1: Yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Kayavikkayasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:53.1: Yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ kayavikkayaṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:54.1: Dasāhaparamaṃ atirekapatto dhāretabbo, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Ūnapañcabandhanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:55.1: Yo pana bhikkhu ūnapañcabandhanena pattena aññaṃ navaṃ pattaṃ cetāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:55.2: Tena bhikkhunā so patto bhikkhuparisāya nissajjitabbo,
pli-tv-bu-pm:55.3: yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto, so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo ‘‘ayaṃ te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:56.1: Yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhesajjāni, seyyathidaṃ – sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā sattāhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni,
pli-tv-bu-pm:57.1: ‘‘Māso seso gimhāna’’nti bhikkhunā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ, ‘‘addhamāso seso gimhāna’’nti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:57.2: Orena ce ‘‘māso seso gimhāna’’nti vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyeseyya, orena‘‘ddhamāso seso gimhāna’’nti katvā nivāseyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Cīvaraacchindanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:58.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Suttaviññattisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:59.1: Yo pana bhikkhu sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Mahāpesakārasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:60.1: Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:60.2: ‘‘idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañca karotha, vitthatañca, appitañca, suvītañca, suppavāyitañca, suvilekhitañca, suvitacchitañca karotha,
pli-tv-bu-pm:60.3: appeva nāma mayampi āyasmantānaṃ kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyyāmā’’ti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:60.4: Evañca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya antamaso piṇḍapātamattampi, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Accekacīvarasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:61.1: Dasāhānāgataṃ kattikatemāsikapuṇṇamaṃ bhikkhuno paneva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā yāva cīvarakālasamayaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:61.2: Tato ce uttari nikkhipeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Sāsaṅkasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:62.1: Upavassaṃ kho pana kattikapuṇṇamaṃ yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni senāsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni, tathārūpesu bhikkhu senāsanesu viharanto ākaṅkhamāno tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipeyya, siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:62.2: chārattaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabbaṃ. Tato ce uttari vippavaseyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Pariṇatasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:63.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:64.1: Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:65.1: Ime kho panāyasmanto dvenavuti pācittiyā Dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti. Musāvādasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:69.1: Yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannaṃ padaso dhammaṃ vāceyya, pācittiyaṃ. Paṭhamasahaseyyasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:70.1: Yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttaridirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Dutiyasahaseyyasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:71.1: Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Dhammadesanāsikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:72.1: Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmassa uttarichappañcavācāhi dhammaṃ deseyya aññatra viññunā purisaviggahena, pācittiyaṃ. Bhūtārocanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:73.1: Yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannassa uttarimanussadhammaṃ āroceyya, bhūtasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ. Duṭṭhullārocanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:74.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa āroceyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, pācittiyaṃ. Pathavīkhaṇanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:75.1: Yo pana bhikkhu pathaviṃ khaṇeyya vā khaṇāpeyya vā pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:79.1: Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghikaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā bhisiṃ vā kocchaṃ vā ajjhokāse santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto neva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ. Dutiyasenāsanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:80.1: Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre seyyaṃ santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto neva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ. Anupakhajjasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:81.1: Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre jānaṃ pubbupagataṃ bhikkhuṃ anupakhajja seyyaṃ kappeyya ‘‘yassa sambādho bhavissati, so pakkamissatī’’ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ. Nikkaḍḍhanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:82.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ kupito anattamano saṅghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍheyya vā nikkaḍḍhāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ. Vehāsakuṭisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:83.1: Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ. Mahallakavihārasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:84.1: Mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggaḷaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhiparikammāya dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ appaharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ, tato ce uttari appaharitepi ṭhito adhiṭṭhaheyya, pācittiyaṃ. Sappāṇakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:85.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ tiṇaṃ vā mattikaṃ vā siñceyya vā siñcāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:86.1: Yo pana bhikkhu asammato bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Atthaṅgatasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:87.1: Sammatopi ce bhikkhu atthaṅgate sūriye bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Bhikkhunupassayasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:88.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhunupassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:88.2: Tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānā hoti bhikkhunī, ayaṃ tattha samayo. Āmisasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:89.1: Yo pana bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya ‘‘āmisahetu therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantī’’ti, pācittiyaṃ. Cīvaradānasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:90.1: Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ dadeyya aññatra pārivattakā, pācittiyaṃ. Cīvarasibbanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:91.1: Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ sibbeyya vā sibbāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ. Saṃvidhānasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:92.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantarampi aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:92.2: Tatthāyaṃ samayo, satthagamanīyo hoti maggo, sāsaṅkasammato, sappaṭibhayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo. Nāvābhiruhanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:93.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhiruheyya uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyaṃ taraṇāya, pācittiyaṃ. Paripācitasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:94.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ bhikkhuniparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjeyya aññatra pubbe gihisamārambhā, pācittiyaṃ. Rahonisajjasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:95.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:96.2: Tato ce uttari bhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Gaṇabhojanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:97.2: Tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāvābhiruhanasamayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo. Paramparabhojanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:98.2: Tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo. Kāṇamātusikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:99.1: Bhikkhuṃ paneva kulaṃ upagataṃ pūvehi vā manthehi vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahetabbā. Tato ce uttari paṭiggaṇheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:99.2: Dvattipattapūre paṭiggahetvā tato nīharitvā bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvibhajitabbaṃ, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci. Paṭhamapavāraṇāsikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:100.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhuttāvī pavārito anatirittaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ. Dutiyapavāraṇāsikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:101.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ bhuttāviṃ pavāritaṃ anatirittena khādanīyena vā bhojanīyena vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya ‘‘handa bhikkhu khāda vā bhuñja vā’’ti jānaṃ āsādanāpekkho, bhuttasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ. Vikālabhojanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:102.1: Yo pana bhikkhu vikāle khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ. Sannidhikārakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:103.1: Yo pana bhikkhu sannidhikārakaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ. Paṇītabhojanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:104.1: Yāni kho pana tāni paṇītabhojanāni, seyyathidaṃ – sappi, navanītaṃ, telaṃ, madhu, phāṇitaṃ, maccho, maṃsaṃ, khīraṃ, dadhi. Yo pana bhikkhu evarūpāni paṇītabhojanāni agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Dantaponasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:105.1: Yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya aññatra udakadantaponā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:106.1: Yo pana bhikkhu acelakassa vā paribbājakassa vā paribbājikāya vā sahatthā khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā dadeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Uyyojanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:107.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ ‘‘ehāvuso, gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisissāmā’’ti tassa dāpetvā vā adāpetvā vā uyyojeyya ‘‘gacchāvuso, na me tayā saddhiṃ kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hoti, ekakassa me kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hotī’’ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ. Sabhojanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:108.1: Yo pana bhikkhu sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Rahopaṭicchannasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:109.1: Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ raho paṭicchanne āsane nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Rahonisajjasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:110.1: Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Cārittasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:111.1: Yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:111.2: Tatthāyaṃ samayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo. Mahānāmasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:112.1: Agilānena bhikkhunā catumāsappaccayapavāraṇā sāditabbā aññatra punapavāraṇāya, aññatra niccapavāraṇāya. Tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Uyyuttasenāsikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:113.1: Yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ. Senāvāsasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:114.1: Siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo senaṃ gamanāya, dirattatirattaṃ tena bhikkhunā senāya vasitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:114.2: Tato ce uttari vaseyya, pācittiyaṃ. Uyyodhikasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:115.1: Dirattatirattaṃ ce bhikkhu senāya vasamāno uyyodhikaṃ vā balaggaṃ vā senābyūhaṃ vā anīkadassanaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:120.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ bhiṃsāpeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Jotisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:121.1: Yo pana bhikkhu agilāno visibbanāpekkho jotiṃ samādaheyya vā samādahāpeyya vā aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ. Nahānasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:122.1: Yo pana bhikkhu orenaddhamāsaṃ nahāyeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:122.2: Tatthāyaṃ samayo ‘‘diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhāna’’nti ‘‘vassānassa paṭhamo māso’’ iccete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo. Dubbaṇṇakaraṇasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:123.1: Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā cīvaralābhena tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ ādātabbaṃ nīlaṃ vā kaddamaṃ vā kāḷasāmaṃ vā. Anādā ce bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ navaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Vikappanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:124.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā sikkhamānāya vā sāmaṇerassa vā sāmaṇeriyā vā sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ vikappetvā appaccuddhāraṇaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Apanidhānasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:125.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā nisīdanaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ vā kāyabandhanaṃ vā apanidheyya vā apanidhāpeyya vā antamaso hasāpekkhopi, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:126.1: Yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Sappāṇakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:127.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Ukkoṭanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:128.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Duṭṭhullasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:129.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Ūnavīsativassasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:130.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādeyya, so ca puggalo anupasampanno, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, idaṃ tasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ. Theyyasatthasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:131.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ theyyasatthena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantarampi, pācittiyaṃ. Saṃvidhānasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:132.1: Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantarampi, pācittiyaṃ. Ariṭṭhasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:133.2: ‘‘tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:133.4: ‘‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:133.5: anekapariyāyenāvuso antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāyā’’ti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:133.6: Evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-pm:133.7: Yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:134.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathāvādinā bhikkhunā akaṭānudhammena taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhiṃ sambhuñjeyya vā, saṃvaseyya vā, saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Kaṇṭakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:135.2: ‘‘tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:135.4: ‘‘māvuso, samaṇuddesa evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:135.5: anekapariyāyenāvuso, samaṇuddesa antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāyā’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:135.6: evañca so samaṇuddeso bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so samaṇuddeso bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-pm:135.7: ‘‘ajjatagge te, āvuso, samaṇuddesa na ceva so bhagavā satthā apadisitabbo,
pli-tv-bu-pm:135.8: yampi caññe samaṇuddesā labhanti bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ dirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ, sāpi te natthi,
pli-tv-bu-pm:135.10: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathānāsitaṃ samaṇuddesaṃ upalāpeyya vā, upaṭṭhāpeyya vā, sambhuñjeyya vā, saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:136.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadeyya ‘‘na tāvāhaṃ, āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi, yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmī’’ti, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:136.2: Sikkhamānena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā aññātabbaṃ paripucchitabbaṃ paripañhitabbaṃ, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci. Vilekhanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:137.1: Yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya ‘‘kiṃ panimehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāvadeva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī’’ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyaṃ. Mohanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:138.1: Yo pana bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:138.2: ‘‘idāneva kho ahaṃ jānāmi, ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī’’ti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:138.3: Tañce bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvattikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne, ko pana vādo bhiyyo, na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi, yañca tattha āpattiṃ āpanno, tañca yathādhammo kāretabbo, uttari cassa moho āropetabbo
pli-tv-bu-pm:138.4: ‘‘tassa te, āvuso, alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamānena sādhukaṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi karosī’’ti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:139.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano pahāraṃ dadeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Talasattikasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:140.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano talasattikaṃ uggireyya, pācittiyaṃ. Amūlakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:141.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃseyya, pācittiyaṃ. Sañciccasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:142.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadaheyya ‘‘itissa muhuttampi aphāsu bhavissatī’’ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ. Upassutisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:143.1: Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivādāpannānaṃ upassutiṃ tiṭṭheyya ‘‘yaṃ ime bhaṇissanti, taṃ sossāmī’’ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ. Kammappaṭibāhanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:144.1: Yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Chandaṃadatvāgamanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:145.1: Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkameyya, pācittiyaṃ. Dubbalasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:146.1: Yo pana bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya ‘‘yathāsanthutaṃ bhikkhū saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇāmentī’’ti, pācittiyaṃ. Pariṇāmanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:147.1: Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ puggalassa pariṇāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:148.1: Yo pana bhikkhu rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa anikkhantarājake aniggataratanake pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ. Ratanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:149.1: Yo pana bhikkhu ratanaṃ vā ratanasammataṃ vā aññatra ajjhārāmā vā ajjhāvasathā vā uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:149.2: Ratanaṃ vā pana bhikkhunā ratanasammataṃ vā ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipitabbaṃ ‘‘yassa bhavissati, so harissatī’’ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci. Vikālagāmappavesanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:150.1: Yo pana bhikkhu santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchāvikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya aññatra tathārūpā accāyikā karaṇīyā, pācittiyaṃ. Sūcigharasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:151.1: Yo pana bhikkhu aṭṭhimayaṃ vā dantamayaṃ vā visāṇamayaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ kārāpeyya, bhedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Mañcapīṭhasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:152.1: Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā kārayamānena aṭṭhaṅgulapādakaṃ kāretabbaṃ sugataṅgulena aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā. Taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Tūlonaddhasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:153.1: Yo pana bhikkhu mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā tūlonaddhaṃ kārāpeyya, uddālanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Nisīdanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:154.1: Nisīdanaṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikaṃ kāretabbaṃ, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dve vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ diyaḍḍhaṃ, dasā vidatthi. Taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Kaṇḍuppaṭicchādisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:155.1: Kaṇḍuppaṭicchādiṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso catasso vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ dve vidatthiyo. Taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Vassikasāṭikasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:156.1: Vassikasāṭikaṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso cha vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ aḍḍhateyyā. Taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Nandasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:157.1: Yo pana bhikkhu sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ kārāpeyya, atirekaṃ vā, chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:157.2: Tatridaṃ sugatassa sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ, dīghaso nava vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ cha vidatthiyo, idaṃ sugatassa sugatacīvarappamāṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:158.1: Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto dvenavuti pācittiyā dhammā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:159.1: Ime kho panāyasmanto cattāro pāṭidesanīyā Dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti. Paṭhamapāṭidesanīyasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:160.1: Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhāya hatthato khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā
pli-tv-bu-pm:160.2: ‘‘gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemī’’ti. Dutiyapāṭidesanīyasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:161.1: Bhikkhū paneva kulesu nimantitā bhuñjanti, tatra ce sā bhikkhunī vosāsamānarūpā ṭhitā hoti ‘‘idha sūpaṃ detha, idha odanaṃ dethā’’ti. Tehi bhikkhūhi sā bhikkhunī apasādetabbā ‘‘apasakka tāva bhagini, yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantī’’ti. Ekassapi ce bhikkhuno na paṭibhāseyya taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apasādetuṃ ‘‘apasakka tāva bhagini, yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantī’’ti, paṭidesetabbaṃ tehi bhikkhūhi
pli-tv-bu-pm:161.2: ‘‘gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjimhā asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemā’’ti. Tatiyapāṭidesanīyasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:162.1: Yāni kho pana tāni sekkhasammatāni kulāni, yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu sekkhasammatesu kulesu pubbe animantito agilāno khādanīyaṃ vā, bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā, bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā
pli-tv-bu-pm:162.2: ‘‘gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemī’’ti. Catutthapāṭidesanīyasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:163.1: Yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni senāsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni, yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu senāsanesu pubbe appaṭisaṃviditaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā, bhojanīyaṃ vā ajjhārāme sahatthā paṭiggahetvā agilāno khādeyya vā, bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā
pli-tv-bu-pm:163.2: ‘‘gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemī’’ti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:164.1: Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pāṭidesanīyā dhammā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:165.1: Ime kho panāyasmanto sekhiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti. Parimaṇḍalasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:169.1: Suppaṭicchanno antaraghare nisīdissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Susaṃvutasikkhāpadaṃ

pli-tv-bu-pm:183.1: Na bāhuppacālakaṃ antaraghare gamissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:184.1: Na bāhuppacālakaṃ antaragharenisīdissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Sīsappacālakasikkhāpadaṃ

pli-tv-bu-pm:186.1: Na sīsappacālakaṃ antaraghare nisīdissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

pli-tv-bu-pm:188.1: Na khambhakato antaraghare nisīdissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Oguṇṭhitasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:189.1: Na oguṇṭhito antaraghare gamissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:191.1: Na oguṇṭhito antaraghare nisīdissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Ukkuṭikasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:192.1: Na ukkuṭikāya antaraghare gamissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Pallatthikasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:193.1: Na pallatthikāya antaraghare nisīdissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Sakkaccapaṭiggahaṇasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:194.1: Sakkaccaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Pattasaññīpaṭiggahaṇasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:195.1: Pattasaññī piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Samasūpakapaṭiggahaṇasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:196.1: Samasūpakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Samatittikasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:199.1: Sakkaccaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Pattasaññībhuñjanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:200.1: Pattasaññī piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Sapadānasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:201.1: Sapadānaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Samasūpakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:202.1: Samasūpakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Nathūpakatasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:203.1: Na thūpakato omadditvā piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Odanappaṭicchādanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:204.1: Na sūpaṃ vā byañjanaṃ vā odanena paṭicchādessāmi bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāyāti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Sūpodanaviññattisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:205.1: Na sūpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Ujjhānasaññīsikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:206.1: Na ujjhānasaññī paresaṃ pattaṃ olokessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Kabaḷasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:207.1: Nātimahantaṃ kabaḷaṃ karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Ālopasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:209.1: Na anāhaṭe kabaḷe mukhadvāraṃ vivarissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Bhuñjamānasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:210.1: Na bhuñjamāno sabbahatthaṃ mukhe pakkhipissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Sakabaḷasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:211.1: Na sakabaḷena mukhena byāharissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Piṇḍukkhepakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:212.1: Na piṇḍukkhepakaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Kabaḷāvacchedakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:213.1: Na kabaḷāvacchedakaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Avagaṇḍakārakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:214.1: Na avagaṇḍakārakaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Hatthaniddhunakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:215.1: Na hatthaniddhunakaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Sitthāvakārakasikkhāpadaṃ

pli-tv-bu-pm:217.1: Na jivhānicchārakaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Capucapukārakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:219.1: Na surusurukārakaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Hatthanillehakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:220.1: Na hatthanillehakaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Pattanillehakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:221.1: Na pattanillehakaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Oṭṭhanillehakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:222.1: Na oṭṭhanillehakaṃ bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Sāmisasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:223.1: Na sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Sasitthakasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:224.1: Na sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Chattapāṇisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:225.1: Na chattapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Daṇḍapāṇisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:226.1: Na daṇḍapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Satthapāṇisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:227.1: Na satthapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Āvudhapāṇisikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:228.1: Na āvudhapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:229.1: Na pādukāruḷhassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Upāhanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:230.1: Na upāhanāruḷhassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Yānasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:231.1: Na yānagatassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Sayanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:232.1: Na sayanagatassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Pallatthikasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:233.1: Na pallatthikāya nisinnassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Veṭhitasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:234.1: Na veṭhitasīsassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Oguṇṭhitasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:235.1: Na oguṇṭhitasīsassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Chamāsikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:236.1: Na chamāyaṃ nisīditvā āsane nisinnassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Nīcāsanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:237.1: Na nīce āsane nisīditvā ucce āsane nisinnassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Ṭhitasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:238.1: Na ṭhito nisinnassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Pacchatogamanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:239.1: Na pacchato gacchanto purato gacchantassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Uppathenagamanasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:240.1: Na uppathena gacchanto pathena gacchantassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Ṭhitouccārasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:241.1: Na ṭhito agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Hariteuccārasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:242.1: Na harite agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā. Udakeuccārasikkhāpadaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:243.1: Na udake agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
